summary: Runtime administration: status, framework and gate management, analytics, config, diagnostics. One action per call—set `action` and required fields; chain admin steps with separate calls.

toolDescription.description:
⚙️ SYSTEM CONTROL: Retrieves system status, switches frameworks, manages gates, and provides analytics.

ACTIONS: status | framework | gates | analytics | config | maintenance | guide | injection | session | changes | execution_history | skills_sync

Returns: Current state, configurations, or operation confirmations.

frameworkAware.enabled: ⚙️ SYSTEM CONTROL [FRAMEWORK]: Status includes active framework context. Guide reflects current framework.
frameworkAware.disabled: ⚙️ SYSTEM CONTROL: Standard system status without framework context.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The operation to perform: status (runtime overview), framework (switch/enable/disable frameworks), gates (manage quality gates), analytics (usage metrics), config (view/modify settings), maintenance (restart), guide (get recommendations), injection (session overrides for injected guidance), session (manage execution sessions — list/clear/inspect; cancel moved to prompt_engine), changes (resource change audit log), execution_history (chain execution ledger, newest first), skills_sync (export canonical resources to client skill packages — set operation to status|export|sync|diff|pull|clone).
notes: Single-call operations; sequence multiple admin steps with separate requests.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Sub-command for the selected action (e.g., framework switch/list/enable/disable; gates enable/disable/status/health/list; analytics view/reset/history; config restore/validate; maintenance restart; injection status/override/reset; session list/clear/inspect; changes list; execution_history list; skills_sync status/export/sync/diff/pull/clone).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Target session ID or chain ID for session operations.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Target framework for switch operations. Use system_control(action:'framework', operation:'list') to see available frameworks.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Audit reason for framework/gate toggles or admin actions.

parameters.name: persist
parameters.description: When true, gate/framework enable/disable changes are also written to config.json.
notes: Applies to gate operations (enable/disable) and framework system enable/disable.
Uses SafeConfigWriter; falls back to runtime-only if unavailable.

parameters.name: show_details
parameters.description: Include detailed output (status/analytics/framework/gate reports).

parameters.name: include_history
parameters.description: Include recorded history where supported.

parameters.name: include_metrics
parameters.description: Include detailed metrics output (where supported).

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Guide topic when requesting guidance.

parameters.name: include_planned
parameters.description: For guide: set false to leave out operations marked planned. Default: true.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: Filter gates by keyword (matches ID, name, or description). Use with gates:list action.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required `true` for operations that replace or discard state: config restore, analytics reset and maintenance restart. Each refuses without it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries to return, for analytics history, changes list and execution_history list.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: For config: `{ key, value?, operation }`, where `operation` is get, set, list or validate and `value` is the string to set or check. Omit it to list the configuration.

parameters.name: backup_path
parameters.description: For config restore: path of the backup file to restore. Requires `confirm: true`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: For injection override: the injection type to override.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: For injection override: `true` turns the injection on, `false` turns it off. Required.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Read by two actions with different values. skills_sync: `user` (default) or `project` client directories. injection override: `session` (default), `chain` or `step`. Each action refuses the other's values.

parameters.name: scope_id
parameters.description: For injection override: the chain or step id a `chain` or `step` scoped override applies to.

parameters.name: expires_in_ms
parameters.description: For injection override: milliseconds until the override expires. Omit it to keep the override until reset.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: For changes list: only changes from this source — filesystem (a file edit hot reload detected), mcp-tool (a resource_manager write) or external (a change made while the server was down).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: For changes list: only changes recorded since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Resource type filter. skills_sync accepts prompt, gate, framework or style; changes list records prompt and gate only.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: For skills_sync: target client id. Use one of: claude-code, cursor, codex, opencode, or all.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: For skills_sync: resource id filter, or for clone the id of the resource to create.

parameters.name: prune
parameters.description: For skills_sync sync: when true (default), remove stale managed skills not present in current registrations.

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: For skills_sync export/sync/pull/clone: report every file, prune and registration change the run would make, and make none of them.

parameters.name: preview_detail
parameters.description: For skills_sync: how much `preview` shows. `summary` (default) lists the planned changes; `diff` adds unified diffs and is valid for `pull` only, the one command that computes prose changes. Requires `preview: true` — on its own it would not be read, so it is refused by name.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: For skills_sync diff: write .patch files to this directory instead of stdout only.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: For skills_sync clone: path to the source SKILL.md file. Required for clone.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: For skills_sync clone: target category for prompt resources. Default: general.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: For skills_sync clone: overwrite an existing resource directory.

commands.summary: Runtime status overview (framework, gates, health).
Switch active framework with audit reason.
Enable framework system (with optional persistence to config).
Disable framework system (with optional persistence to config).
List available frameworks.
List framework guides.
Enable gate system (with optional persistence to config).
Disable gate system (with optional persistence to config).
Gate system status overview.
Gate system health details.
List available canonical gates with optional search filtering. Shortcut: >>gates [search]
Retrieve analytics summary with optional detail/history; history lists framework switches, reset clears metrics.
Configuration operations (list/get/set/restore/validate).
Maintenance operations (restart).
Guidance on available system operations.
Show injection configuration and active session overrides.
Set a session override for one injection type.
Clear every session override.
List active chain sessions.
Clear a specific session or chain history.
Inspect session details.
List recorded resource changes, newest first.
List recent chain executions from the execution ledger.
Show sync config and manifest availability.
Export skills from canonical resources.
Reconcile clients to registrations (export/update plus optional prune).
Compare canonical and exported outputs; optional .patch output.
Merge exported prose edits back into canonical YAML.
Create canonical resources from external SKILL.md.
